description: This Java class, PersistableManufacturerPopulator, converts PersistableManufacturer objects into Manufacturer objects by populating the relevant fields, particularly handling descriptions and language associations, within a merchant store context.

classes.name: PersistableManufacturerPopulator
classes.description: A class that converts PersistableManufacturer objects into Manufacturer objects, handling description and language details, used in the context of populating data within a sales management application.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a PersistableManufacturer into a Manufacturer, populating descriptions and language-dependent details, and associating it with a MerchantStore.

methods.description: Creates a new Manufacturer instance. Currently unimplemented.
